name: Bakonyszentkirály (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Bakonyszentkirály (a red and white shield with a crowned king, a sun and a stag's head) above a yellow scroll inscribed BAKONYSZENTKIRÁLY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
